A flexible and simple way to split eligible purchases into fixed monthly payments and pay over time using your eligible Citi® credit card.2Explore our business card built for Costco membersCostco Anywhere Visa® Business Card by CitiFAQsDoes the Costco Anywhere Visa® Card by Citi offer cash back?Yes. Here are the cash back rewards categories for the Costco Anywhere Visa Card:
5% cash back on gas purchased at Costco warehouse locations worldwide.
4% cash back on other eligible gas and electric vehicle (EV) charging purchases worldwide for the first $7,000 per year in combined Costco and other eligible gas and/or EV charging purchases. After reaching this limit, cash back drops to 1%.
3% cash back on restaurant purchases (including cafes, bars, lounges, and fast food restaurants) and eligible travel purchases worldwide, including airfare, hotels, car rentals, travel agencies, cruise lines, and Costco Travel. However, 1% cash back is earned on purchases made at certain bakeries, department store restaurants, grocery or warehouse clubs, timeshares, campgrounds, bed & breakfasts, and for train and commuter travel.
2% cash back on all other purchases from Costco and Costco.com.
1% cash back on all other purchases, including non-qualifying purchases listed above.
What are some of the other benefits that come with the Costco Anywhere Visa® Card by Citi?The Costco Anywhere Visa® Card by Citi provides cardmembers with some of the following benefits:
No foreign transaction fees on purchases1
No annual fee1 with your active/paid Costco membership
Cash back rewards on eligible purchases
Is a Costco membership required to apply for the Costco Anywhere Visa® Card by Citi?Yes. To apply for the Costco Anywhere Visa® Card by Citi you must have a current Costco membership in your name. If you're not already a Costco member, you can apply for a Costco membership here.Is the Costco Anywhere Card a Visa® or Mastercard®?The Costco Anywhere Card is a Visa® credit card. Earn cash back rewards with this Costco Citi card on every purchase anywhere Visa® is accepted.Does the Costco Anywhere Visa® Card by Citi have an annual fee?No. There is no annual fee1 for the Costco Anywhere Visa® Card by Citi with your paid Costco membership. Learn more about the Costco Citi Card on our website.Read more Costco Anywhere Visa® Card by Citi FAQsCan I login to my Costco account with the Costco Anywhere Visa® Card?
No, you cannot use your Costco Anywhere Visa® Card to login to your Costco account. To access your Costco account, please visit the official Costco website.
How do you redeem your cash back with the Costco Anywhere Visa® Card by Citi?
Cash back will be provided as an annual credit reward certificate available once your February billing statement closes. Certificates are redeemable for cash or merchandise, in a single transaction at any U.S. Costco Warehouse (including Puerto Rico) through December 31 of each year.
Do you need a Costco membership to get the Costco Anywhere Visa® Card by Citi?
Yes, the Costco Anywhere Visa® Card by Citi is exclusively for Costco members. If you do not already have a Costco membership, you can purchase one at Costco.com.
Can I use my Costco Citi Card as proof of my Costco membership?
Yes, your Costco Anywhere Visa® Card by Citi doubles as your Costco membership ID while you are a cardmember.
Does the Costco Anywhere Visa® Card by Citi have foreign transaction fees?
No. The Costco Anywhere Visa® Card by Citi does not have foreign transaction fees on purchases1 - allowing you to make the most of your credit card when traveling abroad.
Does the Costco Anywhere Visa® Card by Citi offer damage and theft protection?
Yes, the Costco Anywhere Visa® Card by Citi offers Damage & Theft Purchase Protection, as well as Worldwide Car Rental Insurance.
Can you do a balance transfer with the Costco Anywhere Visa® Card by Citi?
Yes, if a balance transfer offer is available on your Costco Anywhere Visa® Card by Citi account.
Is there a Costco Anywhere Visa® Card by Citi for small businesses?
Yes, the Costco Anywhere Visa® Business Card by Citi is designed specifically for small business use. If you're not already a Costco member, you can apply for a Costco membership here.
